teaser: A system gets drawn twice before it is trusted enough to use. That habit belongs to a life path 4 wearing INTP's four letters — a number that asks for foundations and a type that asks for proof before commitment. The 4 wants the structure built; the INTP mind wants to be sure the structure is correct before a single nail goes in. What's particular here is the doubling: not just building, but building against an internal audit that never quite signs off. The reader of this crossing often finishes the frame before trusting it holds any weight at all.
excerpt: The car door clicks shut before the sentence you were building in your head gets said out loud, on a long highway stretch in a rental car neither of you has driven before.
